name: AgentLab
summary: An experiment in AI development infrastructure: planning, building and review roles, with local inference behind a gateway that makes routing and validation explicit.
visualNote: These are architecture and workflow diagrams, not screenshots. The workflow roles are based on an infrastructure audit dated 3 October 2026, not a new live check; the reviewer's model is not identified. Exact runtime model tags and benchmark numbers are deliberately omitted.
